fsri_emissivity.use: Data only. Thermal-property joins stay banned (experiments/banned_moves.md); any TTI use needs a new pre-declared round.

nist_fcd.what: Survey of the NIST Fire Calorimetry Database (doi 10.18434/mds2-2314) for bench-scale cone calorimeter tests (TTI, pHRR, THR per material and heat flux): bulk access, license, size, overlap with FSRI. Download to data/v2/raw/ (gitignored) only if a documented bulk/download route exists; no scraping that the site's terms forbid.
nist_fcd.use: Data only; different population from FSRI. Any modelling use needs a new pre-declared round.
